title: Session rejected after sign-in or sign-up drops you on a blank sign-in form with no message
where: sign-in / Enlist with the Chapter screen, laptop 1440x900
steps: 1. Create an account (Enlist with the Chapter), or sign in with a correct username and password. 2. The login POST /api/auth/login answers 200, then the first authenticated calls (GET /api/users/33/characters and /campaigns) answer 401. 3. Watch the screen.
expected: If the new session is refused, say so (e.g. 'Your account was created, but signing in failed: try again'; or 'Your session ended, please sign in again'). After sign-up, confirm the account exists.
actual: utils/api.js calls onUnauthorized -> gameStore.logout() on any 401 with a token, so the page silently returns to an empty Chapter Admission form: fields cleared, status region empty, no error. After Create account I could not tell whether the account had been made (it had: signing in later hit the same wall). Console shows only 'Failed to load resource: 401'. NOTE: in this run the 401s come from the testing environment's egress proxy (x-proxy-error: 'upstream auth failed: connection CANDELA_BETA'; it fails any request that carries the app's own Authorization: Bearer header), not from the site. But the silent bounce is the site's: any expired/revoked token mid-use gives the same unexplained jump to an empty form.

title: A drive with maximum 0 shows as '0 of 1 available' (an empty pip that can never fill)
where: Lightkeeper's desk, join request > View sheet, Actions (Nerve); same serializer feeds every sheet
steps: 1. Create a Scholar (Professor) and put none of the 9 drive points on Nerve (Professor starts Nerve at 0), as Robert's Pontius Aganus does. 2. As Lightkeeper open the join request's View sheet. 3. Look at Nerve > Available.
expected: Nerve shows 0 of 0 (or 'none', as Resistance does), since the creator and the server store nerve_max = 0.
actual: Screen reader hears 'Nerve: 0 of 1 available.' and one empty pip is drawn, as if the investigator had spent a Nerve point he can get back. Source (read only): backend/vtt/serializers.py line 60/63/66 sends getattr(char,'nerve_max',1) or 1, so a stored 0 becomes 1, while creation.py and rolls.py treat the max as 0. A Refresh would never fill that pip, and anything that reads nerve_max from the sheet (drive spend limits, advancement) sees 1.

title: No way to take an approved investigator off the roster: a player who drops out stays a circle member (votes, reports, resources, the 5-seat cap)
where: Lightkeeper desk: Roster cards, the Lightkeeper's copy of the sheet, Circle page
steps: 1. Approve a join request (Pontius Aganus, account Chilly). 2. The player drops out before the first session. 3. Look for a way to remove him: his roster card opens the sheet (Gear, abilities, Actions, Marks, Deal a mark, Circle spends, Reset drive and ability uses), no Remove/Release button; the Circle page and Finalize slip have none either; Reject only exists on a pending request. Source check: backend/engine.py reject_investigator refuses anything not 'pending', and routers/campaigns.py has no remove/release endpoint (only campaign-wide Retire). 4. Approve the replacement player Ada Quill.
expected: A Lightkeeper can release an approved investigator before (and ideally after) the circle is formed, with a confirm, sending it back to its player as Not in a campaign, like Retire campaign does for everyone, and the circle's counts follow.
actual: Pontius stays a circle member for good. Effects seen: Circle formation lists him as a voter on every part ('0 of 5 voted', 'Open on the desks of Cass, Bram, Pontius, Dev and Ada'); Finalize reads '5 in the circle (up to 5)' so his ghost takes the last seat; Circle resources auto-rose to 6 of 6 ('1 plus the circle's 5 members') instead of 5; he has an Assignment Report card ('No report yet'), and since 'a report not filed counts as no key', the 4-Illumination 'all of you fulfilled a key' bonus can never be reached. Only workaround is Retire campaign, which drops everyone. No console errors.

title: Approve gives no warning that it is final: an approved investigator can never be taken back off the roster
where: Lightkeeper desk, Join Requests card and the sheet's Join request bar (Approve / Reject)
steps: 1. A join request is waiting. 2. Press Approve (on the card or on View sheet).
expected: Approve is one press (fine), but since nothing can undo it (see F030), the Approve button or its slip should say so, or offer an Undo for a few seconds, or the Reject's arm-and-confirm pattern ('Yes, reject') could have a counterpart that releases a member.
actual: Approve acts at once, logs '<name> was approved into the circle.' and the investigator becomes a permanent circle member. Reject has a two-press confirm, Approve has none, yet only Reject can be undone (the player can ask again). With a 5-seat cap, a mistaken or abandoned approval takes a seat for good. Approve of Ada Quill worked cleanly here: card moved to the roster, log line [03:52], 'No one waiting to join'.
